title: No favorite item prompt
features:
This script automatically removes any PromptFrame elements from Roblox's CoreGui.AvatarEditorPromptsApp, including those nested inside folders like "Children". It scans for existing PromptFrames and destroys them immediately, then continuously monitors for any new ones that appear and removes them on the spot. Useful for blocking avatar editor pop‑ups or cleaning up unwanted UI elements on the client side. Simply execute it via an executor or place it in StarterPlayerScripts for automatic execution.

Auto execute is also recommended.

Enjoy the script!
script:
-- add us on roblox vincentplayz9356
local coreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local avatarEditorPromptsApp = coreGui:WaitForChild("AvatarEditorPromptsApp")

local function killPrompt(inst)
    if inst.Name == "PromptFrame" then
        inst:Destroy()
    end
end

for _, desc in ipairs(avatarEditorPromptsApp:GetDescendants()) do
    killPrompt(desc)
end

avatarEditorPromptsApp.DescendantAdded:Connect(killPrompt)
